text:
leslie-fin: Heads-up: small cohort got billed at experiment rate due to a timing/race during a vendor price cutover. 3 invoices and a handful of support pings. tagging ops.

arjun-ops: Which invoices/customers?

leslie-fin: INV-2025-11-03-6607, INV-2025-11-03-6608, INV-2025-11-03-6609; custs: EDGE-1, EDGE-2, EDGE-3. All three should have been preserved per our AB service.

mina-eng: Quick summary: vendor price-file import ran at 02:03 UTC, and our experiment assignment reconciler backfilled at 02:05 UTC. Our price ingest currently applies rows immediately and does not check the assignment timestamps, so rows were applied before preserve_legacy flipped true. Race condition.

nate-revops: So the order of jobs is the root cause. Can we re-run reconcile then re-evaluate billing?

arjun-ops: I'll do a scoped reconcile + billing re-eval. Dry-run first. Command: `./tools/reconcile_assignments --customers EDGE-1,EDGE-2,EDGE-3 --dry-run` Dry-run output:
```
2025-11-03T02:10:01Z INFO -> fetching experiment assignments
2025-11-03T02:10:02Z INFO -> EDGE-1 assignment = preserve (ts:2025-11-03T02:04:58Z)
2025-11-03T02:10:03Z INFO -> EDGE-2 assignment = preserve (ts:2025-11-03T02:04:59Z)
2025-11-03T02:10:04Z INFO -> EDGE-3 assignment = preserve (ts:2025-11-03T02:04:59Z)
2025-11-03T02:10:05Z INFO -> invoices impacted: INV-2025-11-03-6607 -> credit $6.50, INV-2025-11-03-6608 -> credit $0.00 (promo), INV-2025-11-03-6609 -> credit $3.20
```

arjun-ops: Dry-run looks good. Plan live reconcile + credit apply at 02:30 UTC unless anyone objects.

mina-eng: We should also add a timestamp guard to price ingest: ignore/apply-queue price rows if their effective timestamp is older than the latest experiment-assignment timestamp for that customer, or at least delay invoice generation until reconcile completes. I'll open a PR to add a per-customer ingest ordering check and a short-term scheduler tweak to enforce vendor-import -> reconcile ordering.

emma-legal: If credits exceed $1000 please escalate. Standard customer wording ok but avoid language implying broader liability.

nate-revops: Draft customer note: "We apologize for an intermittent billing discrepancy caused by a race during our pricing cutover. We've applied an account credit where appropriate; no action required. Contact billing@redwood.ai for questions." Thoughts?

emma-legal: Change "we apologize" -> "we regret" and add "no change to your subscription terms." Also include refund escalation path.

leslie-fin: Sounds good. arjun: run live now and post results. mina: PR + brief rollout checklist change. nate: send customer comms after credits applied.

billing-bot: Action: credits applied INV-2025-11-03-6607 -> $6.50, INV-2025-11-03-6609 -> $3.20. INV-2025-11-03-6608 -> no-op (promo). Status: completed.

leslie-fin: Nice quick response. Let's add an audit step to the rollout playbook: after vendor import, wait 5 minutes and run assignment-reconcile for customers in experiment cohorts before any invoice generation. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
